martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, today's looking perfect for a cycle, especially between 10:00 and 12:00 when it's a pleasant 20°C with hardly any wind. You might even convince Britt to join you if you promise a cold one afterwards. The headwind picks up a bit later, so make the most of the morning.
